title: Say Solitary Retreat
intro: Diad saray salaysay na madibinon pabor, walay kamarerwa ya agnaparaan so kalinisan to, ya insian ed saray totoo ra pian mananap na panbukbukor ed sakey a sagradon direksion. Ag da amta ya sayan inkaapag-apag et mangiter na tanda parad amin a mundo, sakey a subok na pananisia ya pantongtongan ed andi-anggaan.
clues: Dedikado ak ed bilay na serbisyo antis ak ya inyanak.
Niiyan ak ed panangasikaso na sakey a gagalangen a propita.
Siak so sinustinian na saray probisyon manlapud si Allah ya amabigla ed guardian ko.
Inmarawi ak ed pamilyak tan linma ak ed sakey a pasen ed bukig.
Pinmanengneng ed siak so sakey ya anghil a kaparpara na sakey a perpekton too, ya angitarok na balita nipaakar ed sakey a puron anak.
Nen pinmawil ak ya awit koy kapangiyanak ko, inakusaan ak na saray totook, balet nansalitay ogogaw a mangyagel ed siak.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Milagroson inkilukon tan inkianak na sakey a laki
Say inakmon na sakey a higanten sira
trial.answer: Milagroson inkilukon tan inkianak na sakey a laki

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a nisulinek a pasen ed bukig
Say bato ya nanlapuan na danum
location.answer: Sakey a nisulinek a pasen ed bukig

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Sakey ya ugaw so nansalita pian idepensa so ina to
Nagmaliw ya ambetel tan maligen so apoy
Insuka na balyena ed gilig na dayat
Say biong dinmakmomo ed sakey a palandey
outcome.answer: Sakey ya ugaw so nansalita pian idepensa so ina to

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
